selection: All 48 public final states from the frozen balance trial, then steps 0 and 499 of all eight capped traces; no replacements.
method_order: Rotate fused baseline, whole balanced, decomposed balanced by round plus state index.
timing_scope: One fixed-state H/b construction only; reuse immutable source/map/pose/threshold/kernel. Native Instant clocks, within the requested local Rayon pool.
stage_scope: Search includes transform/native 27-cell matching/ordered pair collection. Count includes temporary targets, exact multiplicities and count vector. Accumulate includes robust weights, J, H/b and parallel reduction. Destroy includes pair/count destruction.
timer_overhead: Decomposition adds four per-evaluation clocks and stage boundaries; retain outer staged time and compare separately with whole balanced. Do not subtract overhead or infer whole-registration savings.
excluded: Map reconstruction, state loading, validation, JSON, source hashing, builds, bag decoding, deskew, sampling, solve, insertion, UI and GPU.
validation: Compare native/decomposed H/b, independently replay all fixed searches/counts/matrices, bind original final and attempted systems. Original sorted final maps are restored in stored order; require ordered target-coordinate parity.
source_scope: All recursive local ca-core Rust sources and Cargo configurations; original build ledger plus supplement. Not a hermetic rebuild certificate.
correction: Four original final snapshots retain 8 or 9 thinned diagnostic points but native begin uses an empty registration source below 10. Prepared-02 mirrors that original dispatch; no sample is replaced. Keep their empty-source timings separate from the 60 eligible-state aggregate.
